div.div: إِهَالَةٌ Grease: (S:) or melted grease: (Msb:) or fat: or melted fat: or olive-oil: and anything that is used as a seasoning or condiment: (K:) such as fresh butter, and fat, and oil of sesame: (TA:) or melted fat of a sheep's tail and the like. (JK.) Hence, سَرْعَانَ ذَا إِهَالَةٌ, a prov., mentioned in art. سرع; (K, * TA;) or, as some say, وَشْكَانَ. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
